agent.name: clara_care_medical_assistant
agent.displayName: The CLARA Care — Clinical & Medical AI
agent.description: Vietnam's #1 safety-first clinical AI assistant for verified drug interactions (FIDES), medical guidelines, LifeMap timelines, and multi-specialty council reviews.
agent.longDescription: Assistant for Vietnamese and international clinical and medical inquiries. Uses deterministic FIDES verification for drug-drug interactions (DDI) and dosage safety checks against Vietnam National Pharmacopoeia (DAV) and DrugBank 5.1+. Provides structured evidence grounding, emergency 115 fast-path triage, and bounded health data processing.

tools.name: check_drug_interaction
tools.description: Deterministic FIDES drug-drug interaction (DDI) and dosage safety verification for active pharmaceutical ingredients or brand names against DAV Pharmacopoeia III and DrugBank 5.1+.

medications.description: List of active ingredients or commercial drug names to evaluate for pairwise and multi-drug interactions.

patient_age.description: Patient age in years (used for pediatric/geriatric dosing threshold checks).

egfr.description: Estimated Glomerular Filtration Rate (mL/min/1.73m²) for renal clearance adjustments.

tools.name: lookup_evidence_source
tools.description: Queries The CLARA Care Living Evidence Hub across DAV Pharmacopoeia III, DrugBank 5.1, WHO Clinical Guidelines, openFDA, DailyMed, and PubMed/Europe PMC.

query.description: Medical search query, drug name, clinical condition, or mechanism of action.

sources.description: Biomedical knowledge sources to include in search.

language.description: Target language for clinical citations and snippets.

limit.description: Maximum number of evidence entries to return.

tools.name: get_clinical_standards
tools.description: Retrieves official clinical practice guidelines, emergency triage criteria (Fast-Path 115), and diagnostic protocols from Vietnam Ministry of Health (BYT), WHO, ACC/AHA, ADA, and KDIGO.

knowledge_bases.name: Dược thư Quốc gia Việt Nam (DAV III)
knowledge_bases.description: Official Vietnamese national pharmacopoeia, standard generic & brand mappings, registered dosages, and indications.

knowledge_bases.name: DrugBank Knowledgebase
knowledge_bases.description: Small molecule & biologic DDI network, CYP450 enzyme metabolism pathways, contraindications, and target pharmacology.

knowledge_bases.name: Vietnam MoH Clinical Practice Guidelines
knowledge_bases.authority: Cục Quản lý Khám, chữa bệnh (Bộ Y tế)
knowledge_bases.description: National diagnostic and treatment protocols for hospital and ambulatory care settings.

knowledge_bases.name: WHO Model List of Essential Medicines & Guidelines
knowledge_bases.description: Global evidence-based clinical protocols, essential medicines list, and therapeutic guidelines.

knowledge_bases.name: openFDA & DailyMed Drug Monographs
knowledge_bases.authority: US FDA & National Library of Medicine
knowledge_bases.description: Real-time drug labeling, boxed warnings, and post-marketing surveillance reports.
